newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dec JGB hits record high as rumours swirl around.
newsitem.headline: Dec JGB hits record high as rumours swirl around.

text.p: The key December Japanese government bond (JGB) contract rose to a record high of 125.75 in mid-morning Tuesday trade, helped by various rumours.

There was a vague market rumour that former vice finance minister for international affairs Toyoo Gyoten had said there was no need for a credit tightening at the moment. This could not be immediately confirmed.
There was also vague market talk that a small Japanese regional bank may be suffering financial difficulties. This also could not be confirmed.
The key December stood at 125.67, up from 125.45 on Friday.
